label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for the eighteen o'clock community gathering: innkeeper and builder are waiting in the lantern-decorated great hall, builder holding a lantern, and freight has arranged and carried out my escort. Secretary knowingly coordinates timing and attendance. I was told about the gathering, but not these setup details; a surprise celebration is possible, not established. There is no reliable evidence of a bridge or port scheme or of baker or neighbour knowingly helping.
